summary: Payroll Settings and PDF Generation features fully tested. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend UI verified with Playwright - Payroll Settings tab, Extra Hours/Less Hours columns, PF/Professional Tax deductions, and Download PDF button all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Existing payslips created before the new schema update do not have extra_hours, less_hours, pf_enabled, professional_tax_enabled fields. This is expected behavior - only newly created payslips will have these fields.
seed_data_creation: Created test payslip payslip_a4d43d6efe17 for May 2026 to verify new schema fields (extra_hours, less_hours, pf_enabled, professional_tax_enabled)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll Settings and PDF Generation features fully functional. New payslips include extra_hours, less_hours, pf_enabled, pf_percentage, professional_tax_enabled fields. Existing payslips (created before update) don't have these fields but UI handles gracefully with defaults.

payroll_settings_tab.details: Payroll Settings sub-tab exists with PF, Professional Tax, and Working Hours configuration sections

pf_configuration.details: PF has enable/disable toggle and percentage input (default 12%)

professional_tax_configuration.details: Professional Tax has enable/disable toggle, amount input (default ₹200), and threshold input (default ₹15,000)

working_hours_configuration.details: Standard Hours per Day input (default 8.0) with monthly calculation display

save_settings_button.details: Save Settings button works - settings persist to database

extra_hours_column.details: Extra Hours column displayed in attendance summary (green color)

less_hours_column.details: Less Hours column displayed in attendance summary (orange color)

pf_deduction_conditional.details: PF deduction shows with percentage (e.g., 'PF (12%)') when enabled

professional_tax_conditional.details: Professional Tax deduction shows when enabled and salary above threshold

download_pdf_button.details: Download PDF button appears for Generated payslips

pdf_download_works.details: PDF download endpoint returns valid PDF file with correct headers

api_tests.GET /api/payroll/settings: PASS - Returns payroll settings with all fields (pf_enabled, pf_percentage, professional_tax_enabled, professional_tax_amount, professional_tax_threshold, standard_hours_per_day)
api_tests.PUT /api/payroll/settings: PASS - Updates settings and persists to database
api_tests.GET /api/payroll/payslip/{id}/pdf: PASS - Returns PDF with correct content-type and content-disposition headers
api_tests.GET /api/payroll/payslips?month=5&year=2: PASS - New payslips include extra_hours, less_hours, pf_enabled, professional_tax_enabled fields
